title: Metadata spine: TMDB + AniList clients and the artwork cache
spec: GET /api/search?q= returns ranked candidates from TMDB multi-search: title, year, kind (anime/movie/live-action), overview, poster and backdrop URLs, tmdb_id, media_type. Kind inference: TMDB genre 16 + origin JP => anime, else tv => live-action, else movie. GET /api/titles/{tmdb_id}/details enriches with imdb_id (from TMDB external_ids — IMDb has no free API, this is the only source) and, for anime, AniList (studio, season, episode count, romaji + English titles; no key needed). Artwork is DOWNLOADED to data/art/ and served by the backend, never hotlinked and never placed in Vite public/ — data/ is gitignored because cached art reveals the list. Cache is content-addressed and re-fetch is a no-op. Handle rate limits and a missing/invalid key with a real error, not a crash. ACCEPT: searching 'cowboy bebop' returns the 1998 anime, the 2021 live-action and the 2001 film as three distinct candidates with distinct posters; details on the 1998 one yields an imdb_id and AniList studio data.
